crossRefs.note: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to…
Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the…
and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Ashtaroth
people.line: A city of Og, king of Bashan.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Edrei
people.line: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
translations.bsb: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
translations.kjv: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
translations.asv: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
